name: School placement & AEIS prep (category guide)
summary: International-school waitlists vs AEIS/MOE assignment honesty — what placement consultants can (and cannot) guarantee for EP/DP kids, and when prep tuition beats a paid ‘guaranteed seat’ pitch.
body: International schools run their own admissions calendars, waitlists, and sibling priorities — a consultant can organise tours and paperwork, not invent capacity. AEIS / S-AEIS for mainstream MOE schools is an exam-plus-assignment path: passing does not let you pick a brand-name neighbourhood school, and foreign-student fees remain unsubsidised even when parents pay Singapore tax. Prep centres and tutors sell exam technique; treat ‘guaranteed AEIS pass / guaranteed school’ marketing as a red flag. Compare total cost of international fees vs AEIS prep + foreigner MOE fees + commute before you hire anyone. Local-school interest still needs ICA Student’s Pass or eligible Dependant’s Pass sequencing — admissions agents do not override ICA. Pair this directory entry with the international-schools landscape, school-waitlist realism, AEIS, and local-schools-for-expats guides. This is a category guide, not a ranked agency league table.
